title: Why hire me
lede: I combine research depth with hands-on engineering. Here is what I bring to a team, and where on this site you can check each point.

reasons.title: I build systems and prove they are secure
reasons.text: For my PhD I designed a virtualised smart-home testbed, implemented Paillier encryption in Python and ran controlled replay, spoofing, flooding and malformed-message tests against it. I understand how systems fail, so I design them to hold up.

reasons.title: I check results before I claim them
reasons.text: My experiments compare decrypted results against plaintext references, account for every message and report limitations next to findings. Your team gets conclusions it can defend to a client, an auditor or a board.

reasons.title: I explain hard ideas clearly
reasons.text: I have taught homomorphic encryption to master's students and support undergraduates as a Graduate Teaching Assistant. I can brief engineers, managers and non-specialists without losing accuracy.

reasons.title: I am trusted to judge technical work
reasons.text: I review manuscripts for Scientific Reports (Springer Nature) and IET Blockchain. That means reading methods closely, testing whether evidence supports claims and giving feedback people can act on.

reasons.title: I ship working software
reasons.text: Alongside my PhD I have built ZeroSeal, Citizen and Omela with Next.js, TypeScript and Vercel. I can take an idea from an empty repository to something people can use.

reasons.title: I keep learning, and it shows
reasons.text: MSc Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics with Distinction, BSc Computer Science with First Class Honours, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity and Huawei HCIA Big Data, and I am preparing for Microsoft AZ-104.

qualities.title: Fast learner
qualities.text: I taught myself Next.js, TypeScript and Stellar development to ship my own projects, and I am now working towards Microsoft AZ-104.

qualities.title: Curious by default
qualities.text: My work spans cryptography, network security, digital forensics and machine learning because I follow a problem wherever it leads.

qualities.title: Steady under pressure
qualities.text: I run doctoral research, five manuscripts in peer review, teaching and journal reviewing at the same time, and I meet my deadlines.

qualities.title: Invested in the team
qualities.text: As a Graduate Teaching Assistant and postgraduate research representative, I put real time into helping the people around me improve.

qualities.title: Honest and dependable
qualities.text: I say what the evidence shows and what it does not. Colleagues can rely on my work and on my word.

qualities.title: Driven to finish
qualities.text: I take ownership of hard problems and see them through, from first design to tested, documented results.
